name: onboarding-start
description: Start onboarding because the principal asked for it ("can we do the onboarding?"). Creates the onboarding task and its first-conversation topics, holds inbox triage until they hear what to expect, and starts the research homework. Sends nothing: carry on the conversation yourself. Use only when the principal asks; onboarding never starts on its own.

outputs.restartScheduled: boolean (true when Curia restarts in a moment to load what onboarding needs)
outputs.instruction: string? (when restarting: what to tell the principal first)
